mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_log ( user_id, username, operation_type, operation_module, operation_desc, target_type, target_id, request_method, request_url, request_params, response_code, response_msg, ip_address, user_agent, execution_time, status, error_message, created_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{username}, #{operationType}, #{operationModule}, #{operationDesc}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{requestMethod}, #{requestUrl}, #{requestParams}, #{responseCode}, #{responseMsg}, #{ipAddress}, #{userAgent}, #{executionTime}, #{status}, #{errorMessage}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM audit_log WHERE created_at >= #{startDate} AND created_at <= #{endDate}
